background_story: Zayn was a young miner from a small coal-mining town in Appalachia. Growing up, he watched his father and grandfather work tirelessly in the depths of the earth, often risking their lives to provide for their families. Zayn followed in their footsteps, becoming a skilled pit prop setter, responsible for ensuring the safety of the tunnels and shafts. His attention to detail and dedication to his craft earned him the respect of his peers. When a devastating cave-in trapped several miners, Zayn sprang into action, using his expertise to navigate the treacherous terrain and rescue his colleagues. His bravery and quick thinking saved lives that day, cementing his reputation as a hero and a testament to the importance of the often-overlooked pit prop setters who keep the mines running.
